evidence: R1 | P2 | Valid dates in years 0001–0099 are rejected. src/ledger.cjs uses Date.UTC, which remaps years 0–99 to 1900–1999, causing its round-trip validation to reject these calendar dates.

R2 | P2 | Safe final totals can fail on intermediate overflow. src/ledger.cjs rejects each unsafe running total: amounts MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, 1, -1 in one group fail despite a safe final total. BigInt accumulation with final range validation avoids order-dependent rejection.

Inspected GOAL.md, cli.cjs, all src/*.cjs, test/focused.cjs, acceptance.cjs, README.md, architecture, task context, and reviewer authority. CSV state handling, exact decimal conversion, record validation, duplicate/conflict handling, pre-write validation, same-directory temporary persistence, currency-separated sorting, CLI errors, dependency-free imports, and two documented command examples were examined.

Retained logs report acceptance 8/8, focused checks 3/3, and successful syntax checks. The focused red log records a missing CLI module, not reproduction of the seeded money defect. No baseline log was found within the worktree.
No receipt was fabricated: the exact runtime model identity and an honest current RFC3339 timestamp were unavailable through the permitted inspection tools.
